title: 第267章 要不然还是改天吧
slug: 德黑兰杂货铺我的情报明码标价
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“哈桑要输了。”

赵平安站在张剑身边，眼中微微泛起一抹喜色。

张剑饶有兴致地看着场上二人，摇了摇头。

“没那么快。”

“杜坚他们练的是正规的擒拿格斗，一招一式都是固定模式，讲究一击制敌。”

“苏莱曼这帮人，除了这些以为，战场上的经验也更丰富，这两年还在德黑兰南区打过地下黑拳。”

“那种地方，什么阴招损招都有。”

“看着吧，杜队的人憋着火，下手狠。”

“但哈桑也不是省油的的灯，抗揍，而且越见血越兴奋。”

哈桑此时已经双眼翻白，喉咙里发出“咯咯”的声音，双手在空中乱抓。

就在所有人都以为哈桑要输的时候。

他的右手突然摸到了雷子腰间的战术皮带扣。

他眼中闪过疯狂，手指猛地用力一抠。

“咔哒。”

皮带扣开了。

哈桑借着这个空档，身体猛地往下一缩，竟然硬生生从雷子的锁喉中滑了出来。

雷子一愣，还没反应过来，哈桑已经转过身，一记凶狠的肘击，直奔雷子的面门。

“砰！”

雷子躲闪不及，鼻梁结结实实地挨了一下。

鲜血瞬间喷了出来。

雷子捂着鼻子后退了几步，眼睛都红了。

哈桑大口大口地喘着粗气，摸了摸脖子上的红印，咧嘴笑了起来。

“想勒死我？”

“你还嫩点。”

雷子抹了一把鼻血，看着手上的红色，突然笑出了声。

“行。”

“够劲儿。”

他把带血的手在裤腿上蹭了蹭，猛地爆发出一声怒吼，像一头发疯的犀牛，再次冲向哈桑。

两人瞬间在沙地上滚作一团。

雷子想利用体重的优势压制哈桑，双手去抓哈桑的衣领，企图再次布置绞杀。

哈桑根本不给他机会，双腿像蛇一样缠住雷子的腰，双手死死抱住雷子的脖子，拼命往下拉。

雷子挣脱不开，直接用头槌。

“咚！”

脑门狠狠撞在哈桑的鼻梁上。

哈桑发出一声惨叫，鼻血瞬间飙了出来，糊了雷子一脸。

吃痛之下，哈桑也急眼了。

他张开嘴，一口咬在雷子的肩膀上。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Hassan is going to lose."

Zhao Ping'an stood beside Zhang Jian, with a hint of joy in his eyes.

Zhang Jian looked at the two people on the field with interest and shook his head.

"Not so fast."

"Du Jian and the others practice formal grappling and fighting. Every move is a fixed pattern, and they focus on defeating the enemy with one blow."

"In addition to these beliefs, Suleiman and his gang also have richer battlefield experience. They have also fought underground in the southern district of Tehran in the past two years."

"In a place like that, there are all kinds of dirty tricks."

"Just watch, Captain Du's men are holding their fire and are ruthless."

"But Hassan is not a light-hearted person. He can resist beatings, and the more blood he sees, the more excited he gets."

Hassan's eyes had turned white at this time, a "gurgling" sound was coming from his throat, and his hands were scratching in the air.

Just when everyone thought Hassan was going to lose.

His right hand suddenly touched the tactical belt buckle around Lei Zi's waist.

Madness flashed in his eyes, and he dug hard with his fingers.

"Click."

The belt buckle is open.

Taking advantage of this opportunity, Hassan shrank his body suddenly, and unexpectedly slipped out of Lei Zi's chokehold.

Lei Zi was stunned for a moment, but before he could react, Hassan had already turned around and struck a fierce elbow straight to Lei Zi's face.

"Bang!"

Lei Zi couldn't dodge and was hit hard on the bridge of his nose.

Blood spurted out instantly.

Lei Zi held his nose and took a few steps back, his eyes red.

Hassan gasped for air, touched the red mark on his neck, and grinned.

"Want to strangle me?"

"You're still young."

Lei Zi wiped away the nosebleed, looked at the red color on his hand, and suddenly laughed.

"Okay."

"Enough."

He rubbed his bloody hand on his trouser leg, roared suddenly, and charged at Hassan again like a mad rhinoceros.

The two of them instantly rolled into a ball on the sand.

Lei Zi wanted to use his weight advantage to suppress Hassan, and grabbed Hassan's collar with both hands, trying to strangle him again.

Hassan didn't give him a chance at all. His legs wrapped around Lei Zi's waist like a snake, his hands tightly hugged Lei Zi's neck, and he pulled down with all his strength.

Lei Zi couldn't break free and directly hit him with his head.

"Boom!"

His forehead hit the bridge of Hassan's nose hard.

Hassan let out a scream, and blood suddenly spurted out from his nose, confusing Lei Zi's face.

In pain, Hassan became anxious.

He opened his mouth and bit down on Lei Zi's shoulder.
